title: 第19章 送松鼠回家金石潭捉鱼第20章 江有林一怒欲杀人
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第19章送松鼠回家，金石潭捉鱼！
江尘上前解开套索，将松鼠握在手里，顿时有些失望。
这货看着尾巴大，身形却比大老鼠大不了多少，没多少肉。
若是今天没收获，他或许会带回去塞牙缝。
可现在怀里有斑鸠，还要去抓鱼，他自然看不上。
而且据说松鼠肉又酸又涩，村民不是饿急了也不会吃。
被攥住的松鼠直面江尘，圆睁着黑亮的眼睛，鼻尖快速翕动。
嘴里不断发出“吱吱”
尖啸，无力着挣扎。
江尘心微动，嘴角上扬：“看你可怜，放你走吧。”
说完顺手将它丢开。
松鼠如蒙大赦，跳开后在雪地上狂奔。
江尘却背起长弓，远远跟在后面。
松鼠速度极快，在林木间飞速穿梭。
这速度，寻常人稍远就会丢失踪迹。
可江尘目力远超常人——哪怕隔二三十步，视线也像蛛丝般粘在它身上。
跑了三四百步，松鼠一跃，跳上一棵大树的树梢。
左顾右盼后，纵身跳进旁边枯木树干内。
江尘闪身走出，嘴角带笑：“原来你家在这。”
他摸了摸半截树干，这棵应该树死了很久，却仍立在一棵大树旁。

他推了推，干枯的树干微微摇晃。
江尘抽出柴刀，一刀劈了上去。
“砰！”
树干陡然一颤。
刚到家的松鼠尖叫着窜出来，又跳到旁边的树上。
这次却没逃跑，一对绿豆眼紧紧盯着江尘，尾巴毛根根竖起。
江尘又劈一刀，干枯的树干彻底断裂。
从缺口处滚出大量松子坚果，如小瀑布一样啊。
“果然藏了不少啊！”
前世就听说松鼠酷爱储存过冬粮食，常把坚果藏满树洞，甚至藏得太多，自己都忘了地方。
他主动放了松鼠，就是想让它“带路”
找自家粮仓。
眼看松子、坚果越掉越多，江尘脸上笑意更浓，直接拿出随身的布袋接住。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Sending the squirrel home and catching fish in Jinshitan!
Jiang Chen stepped forward to untie the noose and held the squirrel in his hand, feeling a little disappointed.
This guy looks like he has a big tail, but his body is not much bigger than a big rat, and he doesn't have much meat.
If he didn't get anything today, he might take it back to stuff his teeth.
But now that he has a turtledove in his arms and wants to catch fish, he naturally doesn't like it.
Moreover, it is said that squirrel meat is sour and astringent, and the villagers will not eat it unless they are hungry.
The trapped squirrel faced Jiang Chen, its bright black eyes wide open, and the tip of its nose twitching rapidly.
Mouth keeps making "squeaks"
Screaming, struggling feebly.
Jiang Chen's heart moved slightly and the corners of his mouth raised: "I see how pitiful you are, let me let you go."
After saying that, he threw it away.
The squirrel jumped away and ran wildly on the snow as if it had been granted amnesty.
Jiang Chen picked up his long bow and followed behind from a distance.
Squirrels are extremely fast and fly through the trees.
At this speed, ordinary people would lose track if they were farther away.
But Jiang Chen's eyesight is far beyond that of ordinary people - even if it is twenty or thirty steps away, his eyes are still stuck on it like spider threads.
After running three or four hundred steps, the squirrel jumped onto the top of a big tree.
After looking left and right, he jumped into the trunk of a dead tree nearby.
Jiang Chen ducked out and said with a smile, "So your home is here."
He touched half of the trunk. This tree must have been dead for a long time, but it was still standing next to a big tree.
He pushed, and the dry trunk swayed slightly.
Jiang Chen took out his hatchet and struck it with one blow.
"Bang!"
The tree trunk trembled suddenly.
The squirrel that had just arrived came out screaming and jumped onto the tree next to it.
This time, he didn't run away. He stared at Jiang Chen with a pair of mung bean eyes and his tail hairs stood up.
Jiang Chen slashed again, and the dry tree trunk was completely broken.
A large number of pine nuts rolled out from the gap, like a small waterfall.
"Sure enough, there is quite a lot hidden!"
In my previous life, I heard that squirrels love to store food for winter. They often hide nuts in tree holes, and even hide so many nuts that they forget the place.
He took the initiative to let the squirrel go, just to let it "lead the way"
Find your own granary.
Seeing more and more pine nuts and nuts falling out, Jiang Chen's smile became even stronger and he took out the bag he was carrying to catch them.
